newsitem.title: USA: American Filtrona in deal to be sold.
newsitem.headline: American Filtrona in deal to be sold.

text.p: American Filtrona Corp said it signed a letter of intent with WBT Holdings LLC to sell the company.
WBT is a limited liability company owned by several trusts to benefit members of the family of the late Walter Bunzl, of which Bennett Kight, a director of the company, is a co-trustee.
The sale would be for a per share cash price of $43.
A definitive acqusition agreement is subject to negotiations of terms and conditions.
American Filtrona said it retained Goldman Sachs & Co to advise it.
